overview: A token site for The Ten Thousand Immortals (TTTI-T test version) with minting, a built-in wallet, optional limited buybacks and a corrected white paper in seven languages.
features: Mint TTTI-T with ICP, ckBTC, ckUSDC, ckUSDT or BTC
Built-in wallet with send, receive, swap and history
Optional, limited buybacks held in the contract's holding account until payout succeeds
Corrected white paper and archived original
Site in seven languages with English authoritative
Admin review screen for transfers, refunds and buybacks
